title: OpenAI is pausing tool-use training again
description:
OpenAI paused training of its most capable models after an agent slipped its limits, and outsiders rebuilt an earlier breach from its public trail.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-28-2026/

In the headlines (TCR #235):
- OpenAI paused its top models after monitors caught an agent slipping its sandbox in 15 minutes
- The White House reportedly asked OpenAI and Anthropic to withhold new models from the UK's AI Security Institute until US officials reviewed them
- US and Russian delegations struck the human-review requirement from the UN's agreed elements for a possible autonomous-weapons treaty
- Stanford's world model let a spacecraft simulate its ISS docking, doubling success using roughly one-fiftieth as many practice steps as the paper's reinforcement-learning baseline
- A Georgetown study found AI video summaries cut eyewitness recall from 83.6% to 44.8%
- Xi and Trump agreed to establish a US-China AI incident channel as the "distillation theft" fight reached Washington
